correctness.rationale: The isolated-unit criterion and corner formulas are correct. If 1_{x} is a Steinberg element, local constancy forces {x} open; conversely an isolated unit and a compact-open bisection isolate every arrow with source x. Hence isotropy point masses form e_xAe_x, and Ae_x is the finitely supported source-fibre module. The right isotropy action is free, so Ae_x is a direct sum of copies of R[G_x], giving the stated tensor-Hom corner adjunction and exactness.

originality.rationale: The central correction is already contained in the broader 18 September SCOPE record `kumjian-pask-corners-isotropy-singletons--7d767a2e5900`, which states the same open-singleton iff point-mass criterion, applies it to arXiv:2609.20230v1, identifies e_xAe_x with the isotropy group algebra, and gives the same unital corner restriction e_xM. The remaining source-fibre induction/freeness mechanism is established prior Steinberg-algebra theory rather than a new residual theorem.

scientific_value.rationale: As a standalone validated finding this package duplicates an already accepted correction and adds only standard consequences of the source-fibre bimodule. Keeping both would fragment the same correction rather than add an independent scientific result.
